messages:
marco_sales: Quick heads-up 10k-seat customer Northbridge wants a 2-week Private deployment POC. Must use PrivateLink for control-plane, and they insist on a small set of stable public egress IPs so their DLP/proxy team can whitelist. They also asked if we support proxy-auth (NTLM/Kerberos) and customer-managed KMS. Adding @anya_platform and @leo_netops for tech & network.

anya_platform: Welcome. Short answers: CMKs yes for Private. NTLM/Kerberos client auth from our runtime -> proxy is not supported. Options: 1) run egress through our NAT with reserved EIPs (recommended), 2) use their proxy with Basic auth or token-based proxy authentication, or 3) VPC peering if they can accept route changes.

leo_netops: Firewall snippet example for option 1 (egress via our NAT EIPs):
```
# Customer outbound allowlist (example)
ALLOW TCP 443 TO 54.203.11.101,54.203.11.102  # control-plane EIPs (us-east-1)
ALLOW TCP 8443 TO 54.203.11.110                 # runtime EIP (dedicated)
# DNS: allow outbound to their resolver or to 8.8.4.4
# If they insist on FQDN-only, we provide cert names but they prefer IPs for TLS-inspect environments
```
Will replace with final EIPs per-region in the SOW.

sre-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 summary and SRE runbook to the POC handoff doc.

marco_sales: They explicitly said their proxy does TLS re-sign and blocks unknown CAs. If we go NAT EIP path, do we still need any cert changes on their side?

anya_platform: No cert changes if NAT EIP used; traffic exits to internet and appears from our EIPs. If they use PrivateLink+their proxy intercepts, they'd need to trust our client certs in their proxy. NAT is least friction.

leo_netops: Pricing ballpark for 14-day POC (pro-rated): setup eng: $1,250; Dedicated compute: ~$2,000; NAT/EIP appliance & reserved EIPs (pro-rated): ~$300. Bandwidth billed per-GB (estimate needed). We can offer a flat POC bundle $3,400 to simplify. If they want Hosted comparison: Hosted baseline for same traffic would be ~40% lower on infra but lacks static egress guarantee.

security: Send us their security questionnaire items; we can add standard replies (KMS, retention, key rotation cadence). We have SOC2 Type II and pen-test summary available.

marco_sales: Action items: 1) leo -> produce final EIP list + polished firewall snippet (ETA 24h). 2) anya -> draft POC quote & SOW with the $3.4k bundle option and delta vs Hosted (ETA 24h). 3) security -> prep SOC2 + runbook bundle for upload. I'll ask Northbridge whether they prefer NAT EIPs or proxy-auth and post back. :thumbsup:
